title: SessionContextResource
description: Session bootstrap: the signed-in account, its owner profile and dashboard configuration, its site and unit counts, and the server time. Never carries a token.

user.description: The signed-in account; the same shape as CurrentUserResponse

email.description: Email on the profile; null without a profile

owner_profile.description: The owner profile, in full; null for a technician

dashboard_config.description: The dashboard configuration; null while not set up

counts.description: Sites and units of the owner; both 0 for a technician

server_time.description: Server time of the read, UTC
